title: Shrugger
description: This mod adds the /shrug command to send a shrug face in the chat.
body:
This mod adds the `/shrug` command to send a shrug face in the chat. That is all.

¯\\\_(ツ)\_/¯


Shrug when you don't know. Shrug when asked something you don't know. Shrug anytime.


The mod is open-source! Github link: https://github.com/Fleny113/shrugger
